name: Mondelez North America Headquarters / East Hanover Bakery Campus - East Hanover NJ
type: Corporate HQ + active manufacturing/distribution campus (Nabisco bakery)

fieldNotes.location: Roster coords (40.8126,-74.3676) were a city centroid landing in Restland/Whippany-area cemetery green space ~600m east of the real site. Resolved to the Mondelez East Hanover industrial campus at 100 DeForest Ave via web research + satellite. Locked center 40.8120,-74.3738.
fieldNotes.facilityType: This is NOT a pure office. The East Hanover address is Mondelez's North America HQ, but the campus is a large multi-building industrial complex housing the Nabisco East Hanover bakery and a major distribution operation. Satellite shows extensive truck activity: long warehouse rows, dock aprons on multiple building faces, and 100+ trailers parked across two large drop areas. Freight relevance is HIGH.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Campus is a private internal-road industrial complex set well back from public roads (DeForest Ave). Public Street View only reaches the adjacent retail plaza and brick building exteriors, not the truck entrance. A controlled/fenced perimeter with internal access roads is visible in satellite; a guarded gate is the strong norm for a corporate-HQ-grade industrial campus of this size — classified true with guardShack true, but flagged uncertain because the booth itself was not directly imaged.
fieldNotes.railServed: Street View on the NW frontage shows a rail spur running along the base of a brick Mondelez building - confirms rail service into the property.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Confirmed campus: 8+ distinct large buildings, mix of warehouse rows and an office-profile structure at the NW end.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide internal aprons and abundant paved width seen in satellite.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: 90 is an overhead estimate across multiple building faces; bands clearly land in 50+.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale positively identified in available imagery; left false.

verification.rationale: Active NA HQ plus Nabisco bakery/DC campus; current careers reqs and food-manufacturer classification confirm operations; no closure/sale (the 2021 NJ closure was Fair Lawn, a separate site). Freight-relevant.
